instruction: Move the rusty-looking grayish metallic cup onto the top of the gray plate for dining.

source.instruction: Move the rusty-looking grayish metallic cup onto the top of the gray plate for dining.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the container, which was at x = -26 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm above the cup at (-30, -3.5, 92) and orient downwards.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +15, -2) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +18 cm (vertical) from the container

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -4, 92) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper to z=82 to encompass the cup, then close gripper.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -10) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the container; closed the gripper (opening 0.07: holding the container)

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -4, 82) opening 0.07; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift left arm by 10 cm to z=92 to clear the table.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +10) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the container

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -4, 92) opening 0.08; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm slightly up and horizontally toward the plate center around (-13, -14, 95).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+16, -10, +3) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the container

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-13, -14, 95) opening 0.08; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Fine-adjust position to plate center, lower cup to z=86, and release gripper.
